title: shot glasses with square design
text: shot glasses with square design. So... These are stylish, standard size shot glasses....I use these in a holder I designed and was made by my husband - makes walking around with appetizer offerings while visiting with guests... that part aside -  You can make shot drinks in them, obviously, but I mostly use them when making appetizers, mini veggie sticks with dill cream cheese or ranch dip in the bottom... mini seafood salads or shrimp cocktails... I've been mini layered dips... tall deviled eggs.... and many mini desserts in them with mini spoons/forks. Dishwasher safe... and nicer than ordinary shot glasses... a little more style....I like them for my purposes (food wise) because the top opening seems to me to be bigger than the more standard looking shot glasses. Eh.. they just look better than the plain ones.  Also, if you're into the booze part... it came with a pour spout as an added bonus.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
